faq.a: The subscription is monthly and renews automatically. You can cancel it at any time. After cancellation, you will have access to premium features until the end of the current billing period.
Yes, you can switch from the free plan to a premium plan and vice versa at any time. When upgrading to a premium plan, you will get immediate access to all features.

faq.q: Is AI Psychologist a substitute for a real psychologist?
faq.a: No, AI Psychologist is not a substitute for professional psychological care. It is a supplementary tool for supporting mental well-being. In case of serious problems, we always recommend seeking professional help.

faq.q: How is my data security ensured?
faq.a: Your conversations are encrypted. For details on data storage, please see our Privacy Policy.

faq.q: What is the Next-Gen RAG system?
faq.a: Our AI assistant uses a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture – connecting a language model with its own expert psychological database. This allows it to provide accurate, contextually tailored responses in real time, based on verified knowledge and your situation.
